# Country scope: subject experiencing loyalty strain or fiscal distress.
oe_wp33_is_distressed_subject = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    is_subject = yes
    OR = {
        subject_loyalty < 55
        liberty_desire >= 45
        num_loans > 0
    }
}
